m: Rub the cutlets with crushed garlic, chopped rosemary, lemon zest, oil and salt. Leave 20 minutes.
Potatoes: boil small potatoes whole for 15 minutes until tender. Drain, smash flat on an oiled tray, oil and salt the tops, roast at 230°C for 25 to 30 minutes until crisp.
Salsa verde: finely chop the parsley, mint and capers. Mix with the lemon juice, a little more garlic, salt and enough oil to make it spoonable.
Cook the cutlets in a very hot pan or on the BBQ, 2 to 3 minutes a side, holding them fat-side down for the first minute to render it. Rest 5 minutes.
Salad: lettuce and cucumber with lemon and oil.
Serve the cutlets with salsa verde spooned over, potatoes and salad.
l: Pack the cutlets with potatoes and salad, salsa verde on the side. Eat at room temp, not reheated.
